verdict_text: NO: The merge computes `out = base + λ(ft1-base)` then applies `λ(ft2-tmp)` to that intermediate result instead of computing both task vectors against the unmodified base, violating the ordering requirement in step 2 (`out[X] = base[X] + λ(ft1[X]-base[X]) + λ(ft2[X]-base[X])`). This yields `base + λ(f1-b) + λ(f2-b) - λ²(f2-f1)`, an extra `λ²` cross term not present in the spec's formula, so merged values will fail the 1e-5 relative Frobenius error check.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
